Images are omitted from output when skipImages is true

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Before <img src='test.jpg' alt='photo'> After</p>", HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(skip_images: true))
puts result.content.inspect
```
